summary_en: FY12/26 final dividend raised ¥1 to ¥23/share; annual dividend now ¥45/share (prior estimate ¥44). Rationale: ROE and DOE, combined with earnings performance. Prior-year FY12/25 annual dividend ¥43.
title_en: Notice of Revision to FY2026 Final Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Shizuoka Gas announced on 5 August 2026 that its board has approved an increase to the FY12/26 final dividend forecast. The company raises the final dividend by ¥1 per share from the prior estimate of ¥22 to ¥23; combined with the interim dividend of ¥22 (unchanged from prior estimate), the full-year dividend forecast rises to ¥45 per share, versus the prior-year FY12/25 total of ¥43 per share. The revision reflects a comprehensive assessment of earnings performance, ROE (return on equity), and DOE (dividend-on-equity), a metric combining the dividend payout ratio with shareholder capital returns.
